bio.text: Andre Easton is a member of the Party for Socialism and Liberation who, as of December 2025, was campaigning as an independent for New York's 15th Congressional District in the Bronx, the seat held by Rep. Ritchie Torres.
He is a high school teacher with 14 years of experience in South Bronx schools, and his congressional campaign is his first run for office.

sources.title: Andre Easton brings classroom-style learning and socialist values to his Congressional campaign
